summary: Alphabet reported Q1 2026 EPS $5.11 (vs $2.64 estimate), net income $62.58B (+81% YoY), revenue $109.9B (vs $107.2B estimate). Google Cloud $20.03B (+63% YoY), first time exceeding $20B. Cloud backlog nearly doubled QoQ to over $460B. 2026 capex raised to $190B, 2027 capex to 'significantly increase'. Shares soared ~10% post-earnings. Google I/O scheduled May 19-20.
